reference_data: AAPL (US) OHLCV + S&P 500 market context; pre-trained AAPL .h5 checkpoints shipped

verified_input_shapes.cnn: train_X.reshape((samples, n_features, 1)) — the FEATURE axis is used as the Conv1D time axis (seq_length=3 refers to OHLCV lag COLUMNS T-0..T-2, not the conv time axis)
verified_input_shapes.implication: kernels 8/6 only 'fit' because the feature axis (~30-40 wide) is treated as time; the PSX adaptation replaces this with a genuine 30-step time axis

target.original: PREDICTION_AHEAD=1 — next-day future close price (regression), MinMax-scaled
target.defect_objective_mismatch: feature selection (FeatureSelector, task='regression', eval_metric='auc') runs against a BINARY daily-return-direction label (Returns>0) while the forecast target is next-day close — objective mismatch

feature_engineering.family: OHLCV T-0..T-2 columns, MA5/10/20/60/120, ADX(14), ADXR(14), MACD(12,26,9), RSI(14), BBANDS(5,2,2), AD, ATR(14), HT_DCPERIOD, High/Open, Low/Open, Close/Open
feature_engineering.defect_ma_collision: ta['MA5'] = tb.MA(close,5) is OVERWRITTEN by tb.MA(volume,5) — same for MA10/MA20 (close MAs 5/10/20 lost)

leakage_defects_identified: scalers (Normalizer/StandardScaler/MinMaxScaler) fit on the FULL feature history before any split
feature selection performed before a clean walk-forward split
objective mismatch: directional label for selection vs close-price regression target
model.fit uses shuffle=True + generic validation_split=0.2 (no chronological split, no maturity purge)

assumptions: US-style cost assumptions; options/premium hedging context — NOT portable to PSX
backtesting.psx_decision: NOT ported; Task 99 uses Latent.pk's strategy-engine + PSX User Schedule V2

psx_adaptation_summary.time_axis: genuine 30-step sequences (SEQ=30) of the same feature vector
psx_adaptation_summary.targets: 5d/10d/21d forward-return regression, output_dim=3 (primary); 1-day-ahead reproduction experiment separate
psx_adaptation_summary.leakage: chronological 60/20/20 split, strict 21-session maturity purge, train-only scaler + feature selection
psx_adaptation_summary.market_context: EXCLUDED — no genuine KSE-100 series in the DB; synthetic proxy forbidden
psx_adaptation_summary.indicators: numpy/pandas equivalents (TA-Lib not installed); HT_DCPERIOD as Ehlers-style approximation
